opening.argument: The offer asks viewers to place at least $100 in Bitcoin into a trading pool, while assuring them that no trading knowledge is necessary and that they can simply watch their Bitcoin grow daily. The presentation reinforces that passive-income message with an average daily profit of 0.5%, describing the opportunity as a way to relax and claiming that members can pay expenses, school fees, and purchases previously beyond reach. Although a warning says historical results do not guarantee future results, the repeated assurances of easy growth and the invitation to join drive the message. The opportunity also offers bonuses tied to building a two-leg recruiting team, further supporting the return-focused pitch.

citations.quote: When you register with Maior trading International, you can join with a minimum of $100 worth of Bitcoin which will go into a trading pool.
Once your Bitcoin is received in your MTI account your Bitcoin from part of the total Trading Pool then you can sit back, relax and watch your Bitcoin grow daily.
You can relax because your Bitcoin is growing and the percentage of 0.49% is really good.
